name: Vårgårda Open 2012
information:
Participation fee will be 100 SEK. The number of competitors is limited to 60. If the limit is reached we may put additional people on a waiting list. On Saturday evening there will be a small barbecue outside the venue. For further information see competition webpage.
We have 10.000 SEK in prize money 5000 SEK to the winner 5000 SEK to the best Swede. If a Swede wins he/she gets 7500 SEK and the 2nd place will get 2500 SEK. All the prize money is for the 3x3 finals avg.
